activity.notes: After returning in 871, Svatopluk defeated the Frankish administration and resumed government of Great Moravia, remaining ruler until his death in 894. This Activity is kept separate from the 870-871 first rule because his deposition and imprisonment were historically real.

sources.title: Svatopluk — Hrvatska enciklopedija
sources.citation_text: The Croatian Encyclopedia records Svatopluk's restoration after his brief 871 removal and his rule until 894.

sources.title: Svatopluk, principe della Grande Moravia — Treccani
sources.citation_text: Treccani describes Svatopluk's restored rule after 871 and his successful defense and expansion of Great Moravia.
